blocks.text: B1-15 · The journalistic title
Lesson overview

With the module B1.3 begin to read real or constructed texts as real, without vowels. The first meeting with an Arabic newspaper is the title: a few words, no verb or verb to the imperfect for a past fact, maṣdar in chain, two points and quotes. In this unit you learn the fixed structures of Arabic titles, the vocabulary used there ( ⁧إِثْرَ⁩ , ⁧وَسَطَ⁩ , ⁧عَقِبَ⁩ , ⁧حَصِيلَة⁩ , ⁧جَدَل⁩ ), to distinguish title, subtitle and attack of the article, and to translate a title into a natural Italian title. It is also the basis of the press review from open sources (INT track). Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 126–127), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Grammar G55, dictionary by root, script for speech synthesis, session with tutor; optional: the home page of a news site in Arabic
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize the six main types of Arabic title and their grammar;
2. to understand the present journalistic (imperfect for a past fact) and the chain of maṣdar;
3. read the titles with quote and source ( ⁧الوَزِيرُ⁩ Questions and negatives ( ⁧لَا زِيَادَةَ⁩ …);
4. use the prepositions typical of the titles: ⁧إِثْرَ⁩ , ⁧عَقِبَ⁩ , ⁧وَسَطَ⁩ , ⁧جَرَّاءَ⁩ , ⁧رَغْمَ⁩ , ⁧بَعْدَ⁩ ;
5. distinguish title, eyelet, subtitle and attack ( ⁧المُقَدِّمَة⁩ );
6. translate an Arabic title with a natural Italian title and similar length.
Two-week plan.

blocks.text: What to notice. Four types of title: verbal to the imperfect ( ⁧الحُكُومَةُ تُعْلِنُ⁩ ...), nominal with maṣdar ( ⁧وَفَاةُ⁩ … ⁧إِثْرَ انْهِيَارِ⁩ ...), with source and two points ( ⁧الوَزِيرُ⁩ : ...), negative with ⁧لَا⁩ + accusative without tanwīn ( ⁧لَا زِيَادَةَ⁩ ). ⁧المُضَارِع⁩ The imperfect, the present (grammatical term). ⁧وَفَاة⁩ "Death" is the term "death" or "death." ⁧اِنْهِيَار⁩ Crash. ⁧إِثْرَ⁩ . ⁧النُّقْطَتَانِ⁩ The two points are set out. ⁧عَنَاوِين⁩ : plural of ⁧عُنْوَان⁩ .
2. The six types of title

3. The present journalistic
In titles imperfection ( ⁧المُضَارِع⁩ ) usually indicates a fact that has already happened, as in English "The government announces" . For the future the title uses ⁧سَـ⁩ or an expression of time:

rows: The president will visit Cairo next week

blocks.text: ⁧الرَّئِيسُ زَارَ القَاهِرَةَ⁩ past (rare in titles) The president visited Cairo
The text of the article, on the other hand, uses the perfect and verbal phrase (B1-08): ⁧زَارَ الرَّئِيسُ القَاهِرَةَ أَمْسِ⁩ ….
4. The chain of maṣdar
The title maṣdar compresses an entire sentence. To understand this, put the verbs back (B1-04):

rows: The opening of the museum tobogganing in autumn
⁧طَالَبَمُطَالَبَاتٌ بِإِعَادَةِ فَتْحِ المَدْرَسَةِ⁩ ⁧بِأَنْ تُفْتَحَ المَدْرَسَةُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.⁩ ( ⁧النَّاسُ⁩ )
The reopening of the school is called for

blocks.text: ⁧اِسْتِمْرَارُ ارْتِفَاعِ دَرَجَاتِ الحَرَارَةِ⁩ ⁧تَسْتَمِرُّ دَرَجَاتُ الحَرَارَةِ فِي الاِرْتِفَاعِ.⁩ Temperatures Keep Rising

The method. 1. Find the first maṣdar: is the main verb. 2. Every maṣdar following in iḍāfa is his object or subject. 3. The first concrete name (one person, one thing) says what is spoken of. 4. Reform in English starting from the concrete name.

⁧جَرَّاءَ⁩ due to (usually a negative event) ⁧خَسَائِرُ كَبِيرَةٌ جَرَّاءَ العَاصِفَةِ⁩

blocks.text: ⁧لِـ⁩ (= for the...) for the... time/day ⁧الإِضْرَابُ مُسْتَمِرٌّ لِلْيَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ⁩

⁧وَسَطَ⁩ in the sense of "in the middle of " is different from ⁧وَسْط⁩ Center ( ⁧وَسْطُ المَدِينَةِ⁩ ): In the titles it is almost always the first. ⁧قُبَيْل⁩ is the short of ⁧قَبْل⁩ : “shortly before”.
8. Title, subtitle, attack
An online news usually has four levels:

rows: the first sentence: who, what, where, when (verbal phrase to the perfect)

blocks.text: Read fast. For a press review read title, subtitle and attack: they usually already contain the The rest of the article adds details, quotes and context.
9. Translating a Title
1. Understand the news by rebuilding the sentence (section 4).
2. Choose the Italian scheme: verb to present at the beginning ('Crolla un edificio'), nominal syntagma ('Vertice') Arabic in Riad.), source + two points (....)
3. Respects the length: an Italian title of 5–10 words.
4. Do not translate the words-signal to the letter: ⁧عَاجِلٌ⁩ → • Last hour • ⁧بِالفِيدْيُو⁩ →
5. Check your own numbers and names (ONO-03).

rows: Increase in the budget of flood victims to 20
Floods, the victims rise to twenty
Polemic around the decision to cancel the festival

blocks.text: ⁧الأَسْعَارُ تُوَاصِلُ الاِرْتِفَاعَ لِلشَّهْرِ⁩ Prices continue to rise for the fourth Price increase for the fourth month in a row
⁧الرَّابِعِ⁩
10. Pronunciation

Read a title aloud. The titles are read as a sentence, with the main endings: irtifāʿu ḥaṣīlati ḍaḥāyā l-fayaḍānāt. On the radio news, the conductor reads them as a list, with a break between one title and another: imitates this rhythm. The two points. The source before the two points is read with a suspended tone, then a small pause: al-wazīr (↗) … lā ziyādata fī ḍ-ḍarāʾib (↘).
11. New lexicon

rows: in the middle of; in a climate of

m. · ⁧مُثِيرٌ لِلْجَدَلِ⁩ In the present case, the Commission considers that it is appropriate to consider whether the measures provided for in this Regulation are in accordance with the opinion of the Standing Committee on Plants, Animals, Food and Feed, as well as the measures taken by the Commission pursuant to Article 13 (1) of Regulation (EU) No 1308/2013, should be implemented.
⁧العُنْوَانُ الرَّئِيسِيُّ⁩ The main title of the instrument is:

blocks.text: Notes of use. ⁧حَصِيلَة⁩ In a headline it is almost always the balance of the victims ( ⁧حَصِيلَةُ الضَّحَايَا⁩ ) or damage; in economics is the "saldo" or the "saldo" ( ⁧حَصِيلَةُ العَامِ⁩ ). ⁧نَفَى⁩ is very frequent: ⁧نَفَتِ الوِزَارَةُ الخَبَرَ⁩ The Ministry has denied the news. ⁧حَذَّرَ مِنْ⁩ • to warn against: ⁧حَذَّرَتِ الأَرْصَادُ⁩ ( ⁧الجَوِّيَّةُ⁩ ) ⁧مِنْ عَاصِفَةٍ⁩ The weather service warned of a storm.
